document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (7): report submission in verify-windows.ps1

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/windows-verify before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the submission step added to verify-windows.ps1, which opens a pre-filled Test report issue in the browser and shows the report zip in File Explorer. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: The submission uses the same approach reviewed in NIXIE-SEC-2026-11-07-6: every field is escaped with Uri.EscapeDataString into a github.com/issues/new URL, the browser opens it, and the tester reviews and submits it under their own account; the script sends nothing and handles no credentials. The issue text contains only the check names, statuses and details, the Windows version, OBS and obs-websocket versions, plugin version and DLL SHA-256, and optional notes. The screenshots and OBS log lines stay in the local zip; the script asks the tester to check obs-log-nixie.txt before attaching it, because a custom image folder path in it can contain their user name. File Explorer is started with /select and the zip path quoted; the path comes from the tester's own -OutputDir or their Desktop folder, so it carries no outside input. The step is skipped in CI and with -NoSubmit.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
